about:
Integrity Equipment Solutions operates from a warehouse at 1230 William J. Clark Drive in Conway, Arkansas. The company was established in 2011 and serves foodservice operators across central Arkansas and into neighboring states. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the founder is not named in available materials.

The business distributes restaurant and foodservice equipment and pairs that inventory with design and installation services. Its team can produce basic kitchen layouts or full floor plans, coordinate directly with architects and contractors, and handle delivery, setup, or complete installation of purchased equipment. A physical warehouse allows customers to view stock on site, though square footage and headcount are not published.

Primary customers are independent restaurants, institutional foodservice operations, and hospitality projects needing new-build kitchen packages or single-unit replacements. The company works with owners, architects, and general contractors from concept through final installation.

Leadership emphasizes that hands-on service — managing the project from layout through install — differentiates the firm from pure catalog resellers. The founder cites more than 30 years of personal industry experience as the knowledge base behind the consulting side of the operation.
